mechanism: temporary price displacement away from a volume-weighted reference can mean-revert when the displacement starts to contract and a strong-trend veto is absent
payer_or_constraint: short-horizon liquidity/inventory imbalance and overreaction rather than unconditional oscillator reversal
implementation_lessons: use a closed-bar reclaim transition after a large normalized extension
RSI is confirmation/normalization only and cannot create the trade alone
target the mean reference while preserving structural stop, timeout and cost budget

sources.identifier: Mallik 2021, Pricing cryptocurrencies: modelling ETHBTC spot-quotient variation as a diffusion process
sources.use: cryptocurrency mean-reversion evidence; not VWAP parameter authority

falsification: reject if extension-reclaim events fail matched direction/time/delayed-entry controls after frozen costs, or if performance requires disabling the strong-trend veto after observing outcomes
